about: Twenty frozen prompts for the economy agent (15 of the 20 must pass). Each is one sentence a creator might type. An agent with the gamesfun-economy skill and the economy_* tools writes a spec for each; save the spec it settles on as <out>/<id>.json (the economy section alone, or a whole gamesfun.json), then score the folder: node builder/web3/economy/evals/score.mjs <out>. Every case first needs the spec to be valid, to check with no refusals, to simulate and to cost; then its own checks, which read the spec, the checker's warnings, the quick simulation and the play-time steps (score.mjs says how). `reference` is a spec that passes the case (tests/economy-evals.test.mjs proves each one does): a fixture, or one written for the case. `ideas` are the entries of builder/web3/economy/ideas.json the prompt comes from. Frozen: change a case only by adding a new one with a new id.

cases.prompt: Make me a coin-flip arena: 2% house edge to people who stake, and a weekly lottery with three places fed by 10% of every flip.

checks.says: a flip box that pays a prize about half the time
a flip gives back most of its price on average (80 to 99%)
players can stake
about 2% of every flip goes to the stakers
a weekly lottery with three places
about 10% of every flip fills the lottery's pot
chance that pays money is flagged
